_comment: W3 — hand-authored TSDoc overlay for event classes that LiquidBounce's source does not (yet) document. Applied by post-patches.sh via a SECOND apply-kdoc.py pass, AFTER the extracted manifest. apply-kdoc skips any class that already has a doc block, so genuine upstream KDoc always wins and these only fill gaps (an entry self-retires once LB documents that class). Descriptions are derived from each event's class name, @Tag and constructor signature in references/liquidbounce; `source` is intentionally omitted so no version-specific permalink drifts. Schema is the v2 kdoc manifest (tools/kdoc-extractor/manifest.schema.json).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ac.doc: Reports the result of adding an account through the Account Manager, exposing the added username or an error.
Reports the result of an Account Manager login, exposing the logged-in username or an error.
A status message emitted by the Account Manager.
Reports the result of removing an account through the Account Manager, exposing the removed username.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Al.doc: Fires to determine whether auto-jump is allowed, exposing the current flag.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.At.doc: Fires when the player attacks an entity, exposing the target entity. Cancellable — cancelling prevents the attack.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Be.doc: Fires when the tracked bed states change.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Bl.doc: Fires when a packet is queued or released by the Blink module, exposing the packet and its transfer origin.
Fires when the player starts breaking a block, exposing its position. Cancellable.
Fires as block-breaking progresses, exposing the target block position.
Fires when a block changes, exposing the position and the new block state.
Fires when the tracked block count changes, exposing the block and the new count.
Fires when a block's collision shape is queried, exposing the block state, position and voxel shape.
Fires to determine a block's slipperiness/friction multiplier (e.g. ice), exposing the block and the multiplier.
Fires to determine a block's velocity multiplier (e.g. soul sand, honey), exposing the block and the multiplier.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Br.doc: Fires when the integrated browser is ready.
Fires when an integrated browser tab's URL changes, exposing the tab index and the new URL.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ca.doc: Fires to cancel the current block-breaking action. Cancellable.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ch.doc: Fires when a chat or system message is received, exposing the raw message string and its component form. Cancellable — cancelling hides the message.
Received-chat message type: CHAT_MESSAGE, DISGUISED_CHAT_MESSAGE or GAME_MESSAGE.
Fires when the player sends a chat message, exposing the message text. Cancellable — cancelling stops the message from being sent.
Fires when multiple blocks in a chunk section change at once (a batched section-blocks-update packet).
Fires when a chunk is loaded, exposing its chunk coordinates.
Fires when a chunk is unloaded, exposing its chunk position.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Cl.doc: Fires when the ClickGUI scale changes, exposing the new scale.
Fires when a value changes in the ClickGUI, exposing the affected configurable.
Fires when the client chat encounters an error, exposing the error message.
Fires when a JWT token is issued for client-chat authentication.
Fires when a message is received in the client chat, exposing the sender, the message and the chat group.
Client-chat message group: PUBLIC_CHAT or PRIVATE_CHAT.
Fires when the client-chat connection state changes, exposing the new state.
Client-chat connection states: CONNECTING, CONNECTED, LOGGING_IN, LOGGED_IN, DISCONNECTED, AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.
Fires when the client language is changed.
Fires when the client's player data is updated.
Fires when the client player's active status effects are updated.
Fires when the client player's inventory data is updated.
Fires when the client is shutting down.
Fires once when the client has started.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Co.doc: Fires when the HUD components are updated, exposing the updated component list.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.De.doc: Fires when the local player dies.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Di.doc: Fires when the client disconnects from a server.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.En.doc: Fires when an entity's equipment changes in a slot, exposing the entity, the equipment slot and the item.
Fires when a living entity's health changes, exposing the entity and its old, new and max health.
Fires when an entity's hitbox margin (used for hit detection) is adjusted, exposing the entity and the margin.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Fl.doc: Fires when the player is pushed by a fluid current. Cancellable.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Fp.doc: Fires when the measured frame rate changes, exposing the new FPS.
Fires when the frame-rate limit is applied, exposing the limit.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Fr.doc: Fires when the render framebuffer is resized, exposing the new width and height.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ga.doc: Fires when the player's game mode changes, exposing the new game mode.
Fires at the start of the main render frame.
Fires on every client game tick (the main ~20 TPS client loop). The most common hook for periodic per-tick logic.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.He.doc: Fires when the player's health, hunger or saturation changes, exposing the new and previous values.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.In.doc: Fires while the client's input is handled each tick.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.It.doc: Fires when an item's lore (tooltip lines) is queried, exposing the item stack and the mutable lore list.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ke.doc: A raw keyboard key press or release, reported with the key and GLFW action code.
Fires when the client's keybind configuration changes.
Reports whether a given key binding is currently pressed, exposing the key binding and the pressed state.
A translated character (Unicode code point) input event, e.g. for typing into text fields.
A keyboard key event carrying the key, key/scan codes, GLFW action, modifier flags and the active screen (if any).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Mo.doc: Fires when a module is activated, exposing the module name.
Fires when a module is enabled or disabled, exposing the module name and its new enabled state.
A mouse button press or release, with the button, GLFW action, modifier flags and the active screen (if any).
The current mouse cursor position, exposing its x and y coordinates.
Camera rotation derived from raw mouse-movement deltas. Cancellable — cancelling suppresses the look rotation.
A mouse wheel scroll, reported as horizontal and vertical deltas.
A mouse scroll routed to hotbar slot selection, exposing the scroll speed. Cancellable.
Exposes the player's per-tick movement input (directional input plus the jump and sneak flags).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.No.doc: Fires when the client shows a notification, exposing its title, message and severity.
Notification severity level: INFO, SUCCESS, ERROR, ENABLED or DISABLED.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ov.doc: Fires when an action-bar/overlay message is displayed, exposing the text and whether it is tinted.
Fires while the in-game overlay/HUD is rendered (after the world, before screens), exposing the draw context and tick delta.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pa.doc: Fires for every packet sent or received, exposing the transfer origin and the packet. Cancellable — cancelling drops the packet.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pe.doc: Fires while the camera perspective is updated.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pi.doc: Fires when a network channel pipeline is initialized, exposing the pipeline and whether the connection is local.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pl.doc: Fires immediately after a jump's motion has been applied.
Fires during a player fluid-collision check, exposing the fluid tag. Cancellable.
Fires after an item interaction completes, exposing the hand used and the interaction result.
Fires when the player initiates a jump, exposing the (mutable) jump motion and yaw. Cancellable — cancelling prevents the jump.
Fires as the player's motion is applied, exposing the mover type and the (mutable) movement vector, so handlers can alter movement.
Fires during the player's movement-tick phase, as movement is applied.
Fires around the movement-packet sync (PRE/POST phase), exposing the position and on-ground flag reported to the server. Cancellable.
Fires each client player tick, after movement has been processed.
Fires when the player is being pushed out of a block collision. Cancellable.
Fires to determine whether safe-walk (ledge edge protection) is active.
Fires when the player's sneak movement multiplier is adjusted, exposing the multiplier.
Fires when the player's auto-step height is calculated, exposing the step height.
Fires after a successful step-up, exposing the attempted and adjusted movement vectors.
Fires during stride-force adjustment, exposing the stride force.
Fires each client player tick, before movement is processed. Cancellable — cancelling skips the player's tick.
Fires when the player's movement multiplier while using an item is adjusted, exposing the forward and sideways factors.
Fires during strafe velocity calculation, exposing the movement input, speed, yaw and the resulting velocity.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Pr.doc: Reports the result of a proxy check, exposing the proxy or an error.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Re.doc: Fires to request a refresh of the ArrayList HUD element.
Fires when the game's resources have been reloaded.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ro.doc: Fires when the player's rotation is updated.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Sc.doc: Fires when the GUI scale factor changes, exposing the new scale factor.
Fires to schedule inventory actions, exposing the action chain list.
Fires when a GUI screen is opened or closed, exposing the screen (null when closing). Cancellable.
Fires while the current GUI screen is rendered (the topmost layer), exposing the draw context and partial-tick fraction.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Se.doc: Fires when a hotbar slot is selected silently, exposing the requester and the target slot. Cancellable.
Fires when the client is connecting to a server, exposing the connect screen, address and server info. Cancellable.
Fires when a server is pinged in the multiplayer list, exposing the server data.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Sp.doc: Fires when the space-separated-names setting changes, exposing the new value.
Fires when the player's sprint state is updated, exposing the directional input, the sprint flag and the source of the update.
Origin of a sprint update: INPUT, MOVEMENT_TICK or NETWORK.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ta.doc: Fires to classify an entity for targeting (target / friend / ignored, etc.), exposing the entity and its mutable targeting info.
Fires when the current combat target changes, exposing the new target (null when cleared).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Th.doc: Fires when a theme color changes, exposing the theme id, the color name and the new value.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Ti.doc: Fires during the packet-processing phase of the client tick.
Base type for title-bar events (title text, subtitle text, fade timing, clear). Cancellable.
Fires when the on-screen title is cleared, exposing whether the fade timings are reset. Cancellable.
Fires when the title fade timing is set, exposing the fade-in, stay and fade-out ticks. Cancellable.
Fires when the on-screen subtitle text is set, exposing the text component. Cancellable.
Base type for title-bar events that carry a text component (title and subtitle). Cancellable.
Fires when the on-screen title text is set, exposing the text component. Cancellable.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Tr.doc: Packet transfer direction: INCOMING (received) or OUTGOING (sent).

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Us.doc: Fires when the item-use cooldown is updated, exposing the cooldown in ticks.
Fires when the user logs in to their account.
Fires when the user logs out of their account.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Va.doc: Fires when a configuration value changes, exposing the changed value.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Vi.doc: Fires when a virtual (custom) screen is opened or closed, exposing the screen type, name and action.
Virtual screen action: OPEN or CLOSE.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wi.doc: Fires when the game window is resized, exposing the new width and height.

net.ccbluex.liquidbounce.event.events.Wo.doc: Fires when the client world is loaded or unloaded; the world is null when leaving a world.
Fires when an entity is removed from the world, exposing the entity and the removal reason.
Fires while the world is rendered, exposing the pose stack, camera and partial-tick fraction — for depth-correct 3D rendering.
